verdict.rationale: Anytype documents self-hosting its sync/backup network using a network configuration and a team-maintained Docker image, and says users can collaborate by self-hosting on their own network. It also offers a headless CLI server mode and a local-only mode with all content stored on-device, so the core product can run without Anytype's infrastructure. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted deployment, and a smooth migration path (switching network mode requires exporting and re-importing into a new identity).
